name: rdm_app_usersetting
label: R&D Management app_usersetting Table
description: The app_usersetting table is a data table under the R&D management module. It is used for related queries and report queries in R&D management scenarios.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: User association ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: app_id
fields.description: The application association ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the user_id, app_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_app_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the app_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
